contexts.text: See Gulf. HH 585. LJ 61.
(The gulf between the solar systems.)
Such are immersed in gulfs, which appear like marshes...
As to the gulfs, into which they were cast... they are many; four have been disclosed to me. Enumerated... The gulfs and the sea are their Hells.
Or into the gulfs where are the Hells of profaners.
They are cast into the gulfs of the west, which appear afar like lakes of fire and brimstone...
Some such are cast into the gulfs which are at the boundaries of the worlds.
There appeared a whirlpool, as it were of water...
They are led to great gulfs, which... divide between the Earths...
a. There is a gulf... whither those are sent who cannot otherwise be subdued... Every nation is separated from the others...
There is a great gulf at the left side. Into it are cast those whose interiors... are completely closed... A vast multitude walk there...
They were all swallowed up in a gulf... This gulf is at the back...
On the gulfs, which also are Hell; the lakes of brimstone. Described.
These also were cast into the gulfs... SE 5220. SE 5229:end. SE 5254. SE 5258:end. SE 5261. SE 5276. SE 5311. SE 5312. SE 5313. SE 5502. SE 5637. SE 5650. SE 5658. SE 5739:end. SE 5828:end. SE 5829.
There was a huge gulf in the west... Thither were brought...
The disposition into order was seen in the southern gulf...
On the eastern gulf.
They who are in the gulfs dare not raise their heads out... SE 5363.
On the abyss... It is a huge gulf...
The gulfs enumerated.
They who have had a communion of wives... are cast into a gulf which is outside the spiritual world of this Earth.
